patch.objective: Use external cueing for freezing of gait, plus gait training and task-specific training, in Parkinson disease; consider cycling over treadmill walking for people at high fall risk or with freezing
secondaryObjectives: Intervention in progressive conditions: Parkinson disease, multiple sclerosis, ALS and dementia, including fatigue and exercise dosing

sources.cite: Osborne JA, Botkin R, Colon-Semenza C, et al. Physical therapist management of Parkinson disease: a clinical practice guideline from the American Physical Therapy Association. Phys Ther. 2022;102(4):pzab302. doi:10.1093/ptj/pzab302 (PMC9046970)
sources.note: Relayed from the DPT case parkinson-freezing-session, not re-read for this band; its note: Read 2026-11-16 in the published article (Phys Ther 2022;102:pzab302) as posted on a University of Oviedo course site (ocw.uniovi.es), through a summarizing fetch that returned quotes; the PMC copy answered a browser check and the publisher's page was not opened. Table 1: physical therapists 'should implement moderate- to high-intensity aerobic exercise', balance training, gait training and 'external cueing to reduce motor disease severity and freezing of gait' (strong recommendations, high-quality evidence); 'should implement behavior-change approaches to improve physical activity' is a moderate-strength recommendation. No dose numbers are taken from it here.

sources.cite: APTA Acute Care and APTA Cardiovascular and Pulmonary, Adult Vital Sign Interpretation in Acute Care Guide 2021 (boards approved March and April 2021)
sources.note: Relayed from the DPT case parkinson-freezing-session, not re-read for this band; its note: Relayed from the REQ-232 DPT stroke case (read 2026-11-11 through a text extraction of the PDF), not re-read: HR rises about 10 beats/min per MET and recovers in 3-5 min; SBP rises about 10 mmHg per MET; orthostatic hypotension is an SBP drop over 20 or a DBP drop over 10 mmHg within 3 min of standing; stop criteria include an SBP drop over 10 mmHg with rising workload and SpO2 below 90%.
